environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint) in us-east-1. Lambda execution role has AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess and SecretsManagerReadWrite. VPC configuration: Lambda is NOT in a VPC, so it has direct internet access and can reach the EC2 instance metadata service (IMDS) at 169.254.169.254. API Gateway has no WAF attached. The upstream service at api.internal.company.com is configured to return 302 redirects based on query parameters (legacy behavior). IMDSv1 is available on the Lambda execution environment's metadata endpoint. No egress filtering or network policies applied.
